title: Surrounded Regions
statement: A board of 'X' and 'O' is given as a list of strings. Capture every region of 'O' that is 4-connected and completely surrounded by 'X'. A region that touches the border is not captured. Return the board as a list of strings.
hints: Do not search for surrounded regions directly. Search for the regions that escape.
Any 'O' on the border, and anything connected to it, survives.
Mark those cells, flip every unmarked 'O' to 'X', and restore the marks to 'O'.

approaches.name: DFS from every O
approaches.explanation: Check whether the component touches the border.

approaches.name: Border flood
approaches.explanation: One flood from the border, then one rewrite pass.

editorial: Flood from every border O and mark the reachable O cells as temporary safe cells. Then scan the board: an O becomes X, and a safe mark becomes O again. X cells never change. This captures exactly the components with no border cell.

examples.explanation: The center region is captured. The border O survives.
